instruction: Notify the owner with the exact action, payout, deadline, risk, prepared artifacts and evidence; continue all reversible work meanwhile.

evidence: Rental Boyfriend Chat Platform 6 days left The goal is to launch a small-scale “online rental boyfriend” experience that centres exclusively on text and video chats. Sessions will be arranged strictly by appointment, and clients will secure those slots through direct messaging rather than an open calendar. What I need built is a lightweight, mobile-first web application that allows visitors to: • create an account, verify their identity and load payment information; • open a private DM thread to request a time slot; • receive confirmation and a payment link once I accept; • join the scheduled text or WebRTC video room at the agreed time. On the admin side I should be able to flag availability hours, approve or decline DM requests, trigger reminders, issue refunds if necessary and view a...
